{{Top|leg}}
A '''Magnetic Clip''' was a component on the [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer]]. Since the [[Ssi-ruu]]k did not wear any [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], the clip was designed to allow the weapon to be attached to tool belts or [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoliers]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
